title: Automation
goal: Automation lanes with Write, Touch, Latch and Trim passes recorded as single revisions, with the documented precision per target.
specSections: Two channels into the audio thread
prerequisites: M2; M4 for plugin parameter automation.

features.title: Automation lanes in the document and segments in the graph
acceptance: Breakpoint lanes compile to preevaluated segments; built-in targets are sample-accurate; interpolation domains as specified; offline and realtime renders agree.

features.title: Write, Touch, Latch and Trim passes
acceptance: Captured values go through automationOutbox with an end marker; one automation.write_pass revision per pass after thinning; no tail values lost.

features.title: Precision contract per format
acceptance: CLAP sample-accurate, VST3 and AU block-accurate through JUCE, documented and exposed to users and agents; tests measure the actual precision.

exit.text: Automation passes are recorded as single revisions; precision is documented per format.
